primary: Native-parsed fences with at least one console observation and no uncaught ReferenceError; exact observations and caught exception name must match. All other cases retained separately.
observation: JSON snapshots at logging time, tagging undefined/functions/nonfinite numbers/symbols; standard well-known symbols normalized by identity. JSON limitations include negative zero and symbol-keyed properties. Does not assert unseen state.
selftest: Six hand-authored controls matched baseline and candidate before fetching MDN. Initial control used unsupported Symbol(); revised to existing Symbol.iterator, revealing internal symbol names, normalized by symbol identity before corpus access.
